{{Event Infobox
| Name  = N'loth
| Image = Event-Nloth.png
}} {{Small Relic Infobox|N'loth's Gift}}
{{E|N'loth}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. It will only appear if the player has at least 2 [[Relics]]. This Event is the only way to obtain {{R|N'loth's Gift}}.

== Options ==
'''Note:''' "Relic A" and "Relic B" will be randomly chosen from the player's currently held [[Relics]].
<br><br>
{{Frame|Offer: Relic A}} {{TS|negative||Lose this relic.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a special relic.}}

{{Frame|Offer: Relic B}} {{TS|negative||Lose this relic.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a special relic.}}
* Rewards the player with {{R|N'loth's Gift}}.
<br>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
An odd creature with a hunched back sprouting several tentacles is scrounging through a pile of trash and debris in front of you. As you approach, he shuffles towards you in a non-threatening manner.
<br>
"N'loth hungry. Feed N'loth."
</div>
<br><br>

{{Frame|Offer: Relic A}} or {{Frame|Offer: Relic B}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Holding the {{TS|gold||relic}} out towards him, N'loth snatches it out of your hand with his tentacles, dislocates his jaw, and slurps down your offer in one quick gulp.
<br>
He gives you a large, toothy grin as more tentacles appear from behind his cloak, these ones brandishing an impossibly neat looking box. He pushes it towards you until you take it.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You shake your head. N'loth hunches even further and sighs, then scuttles away.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* N'loth can pick Relics that activate their effects only upon being picked up, as well as used-up Relics.
** For example, offering Relics like {{R|Mango}} or {{R|Old Coin}} will not remove the max HP or [[Gold]] granted by them, effectively removing the downside of {{R|N'loth's Gift}}.

== Trivia ==
* {{R|N'loth's Hungry Face}} from the {{E|Face Trader}} event references N'loth. There is no special dialogue if the player encounters N'loth while owning their face or if N'loth is traded their own face for {{R|N'loth's Gift}}.

== Update History ==
* '''Weekly Patch 42: Reboot'''
** Adding ambient sounds for N'Loth event.

* '''Weekly Patch 17: Patched in the Face'''
** Seeds utilized for several events for consistent outcomes: Accursed Blacksmith, Cursed Tome, Scrap Ooze, N'loth.

* '''Weekly Patch 5: Happy Holidays!'''
** Nloth's relic choices were alphabetical. Now it's random.

* '''Weekly Patch 4: Full speed ahead!'''
** Nloth now appears in the City instead of the Exordium.
